    <footnotes>
        <footnote id="F1">Represents securities of MSG Rangers Corp. (formerly MSGS Spinco, Inc., and referred to herein as &quot;MSGR&quot;) received in connection with the distribution by MSG Knickerbockers Corp. (formerly Madison Square Garden Sports Corp., and referred to herein as &quot;MSGK&quot;) of outstanding common stock of MSGR to MSGK stockholders, effected on October 26, 2026 (the &quot;Distribution&quot;). In the Distribution, MSGK distributed one share of MSGR's Class A common stock (&quot;Class A Common Stock&quot;) and one share of MSGR's Class B common stock to MSGK stockholders for every two shares of MSGK Class A common stock and MSGK Class B common stock, respectively, in a transaction exempt under Rule 16a-9.</footnote>
        <footnote id="F2">Represents Class A Common Stock received by the Reporting Person in connection with the Distribution pursuant to vested MSGK restricted stock units (&quot;RSUs&quot;), in a transaction exempt under Rules 16a-9 and 16b-3. The shares of Class A Common Stock were granted pursuant to the MSGR 2026 Stock Plan for Non-Employee Directors. Reporting Person received one share of Class A Common Stock in respect of every two vested MSGK RSUs.</footnote>
        <footnote id="F3">Each RSU is granted under the MSGR 2026 Employee Stock Plan and represents the right to receive one share of Class A Common Stock or the cash equivalent thereof.</footnote>
        <footnote id="F4">Reflects the acquisition of RSUs in connection with the Distribution in a transaction exempt under Rules 16a-9, 16b-6 and 16b-3. Reporting Person received one MSGR RSU in respect of every two unvested MSGK RSUs.</footnote>
        <footnote id="F5">Pursuant to the terms of Reporting Person's MSGK RSU award dated August 29, 2024, the RSUs are scheduled to vest and settle on September 15, 2027.</footnote>
